annotations.title: What an economy can be made of

description: What an economy on loot can be made of: shops, loot boxes and packs, gacha, lotteries and raffles, auctions (the highest bid wins, the outbid refunded at once), staking and farms, crafting and merging, seasons and emissions, contests players back a side in, quests and airdrops, holder-gated drops, and NFTs of other collections used in a game. loot is one shared Solana program (on devnet, and on mainnet when the spec says "network": "mainnet"; not independently audited): an economy is a JSON spec, not a new smart contract. With no `part`, returns a short index of every part and topic. With a part, returns its fields from the schema, who acts at play time and its nested shapes; with a topic (writing, cheating, asks, cannot), how to write a spec, designing against bots, asks that look impossible, or what loot cannot do and the nearest versions it can.

part.description: One part, with its fields and nested shapes, or one topic (writing, cheating, asks, cannot).
